digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container manifest inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in drift-scope inheritance and does not poison sibling path declarations, unlike an undeclared child which poisons all child inheritance

Container scope is determined by precedence: own paths yield `paths`; any live undeclared child poisons to `unscoped`; all live children authenticated `none` promote undeclared parent to `none`; explicit parent `none` remains `none`
Cheap resign must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshots without network reads by passing precomputed child impact to `sign_plan_review`
P9 validation passes leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advises only live undeclared children as poisoners, and offers both path declaration and `--none` as remedies
Mixed-scope manifests with both `paths` and `none` children sign only path child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift but become stale on declared child path changes
